## Engine capability backlog

| Capability | Status | Kind | Cards | Spec |
|---|---|---|--:|---|
| `activate-from-zone` | implemented | ability | 2 | Allow an activated ability to declare an activation zone (discard / hand / void) and be usable from there (RECUR / EXHUMATION / RETIRE). The sourceInZone condition already exists; the activation path (getActivatableAbilities, cost payment, source lookup) assumes zone==='play'. Prestige Inversion, Spatchcocking; pervasive later. |
| `activate-while-facedown` | implemented | ability, condition | 0 | Allow an ActivatedAbility with activationZone covering 'play' AND a new condition { type:'sourceIsFaceDown' } to be used while source.faceDown && zone==='play' (bypass the 'a face-down card's abilities cannot be activated' assert for that ability only). 'Reveal this card' in the cost is cosmetic; the card stays face-down unless an effect flips it. 'PETTY VENGEANCE — COST: Use this only while this card is a face-down resource. Reveal this card. Pay 1. ...' (Fired Hand); Vorpal Sword SNICKER SNACK. |
| `activation-limit-per-turn` | implemented | ability, state | 0 | ActivatedAbility.usesPerTurn?: number — a per-turn cap on how many times this ability may be activated (serializable per-turn tally keyed by card+ability, reset each turn). 'Use this only 5 times each turn.' (Vast Mastabatorium, YOU KNOW YOU WANT TO...). |
| `alternative-cost` | implemented | cost | 0 | Cost { type:'oneOf', options: Cost[][] } — the activator chooses one payable branch (a chooserSelectsOption-style pause at activation, or auto when only one branch is payable). 'Pay 1 or destroy a Micromajig token you control.' (Time Traveler Tourist Trap, ENSNARE). |
| `bind-variable` | implemented | effect | 1 | Effect { type:'bind', id, value:NumberExpression } evaluates `value` immediately and stores it in ResolutionContext.variables[id] for later effects in the same ability — so a value captured from a card (its strength/life) survives that card leaving play mid-effect. Merbegon; Pony Slaystation could use it but doesn't need it. |
| `can-block-covert` | implemented | ids | 0 | New Keyword 'canBlockCovert' — a character with it is a legal blocker against a Covert attacking party (declareBlockers Covert check in SpoilsEngine treats it like Covert for blocking eligibility only). 'While there is a token on this card, it ... can block COVERT parties.' (Recyclable Golem). |
| `cannot-be-restored` | implemented | ids | 0 | New Restriction 'cannotBeRestored' — honoured in applyFactionStartOfTurn and the restore effect (same effect as restoreLocked, but grantable as a continuous aura). 'Characters cannot attack or be restored.' (Framptle Tromwibbler — aura over all characters). |
| `card-provides-icon` | implemented | condition, engine | 0 | (1) getThresholds must also count non-resource in-play cards whose definition provides resource icons — 'PROVIDES: [O]' on a character, and the Crest items — not just cards where isResource() is true. getResourceIcons already returns definition.resource.provides regardless of type; only the isResource gate in getThresholds excludes them. (2) New condition { type:'cardProvides', target, icon, min } true when getResourceIcons(target) has >= min of icon — used with cardEnteredPlay / resourcePlayed triggers + target:'eventCard' for 'When a card that provides at least [X] enters play under your control'. ~15 Seed 2 cards. |
| `card-type-equals-condition` | implemented | condition | 0 | Condition { type:'cardTypeEquals', target, other } — true when target and other resolve to cards of the same type. 'You may pick a card of the same type as the discarded card.' (Perturb). |
| `cards-drawn-event` | implemented | event | 0 | GameEvent cardsDrawn { playerId, count } emitted after any draw resolves (draw effect, Develop draw, faction opening/again). 'When a player draws any number of cards, that player may add or remove a token from this card.' (Meat of the Mountain). |
| `combat-restrictions` | implemented | ids, battle | 1 | Extend Restriction with 'mustAttack' / 'mustBlock' (forced combat) and enforce in declareAttack/declareBlockers legality + a UI hint. 94r913 My 908570pp3r5. |
| `continuous-aura` | implemented | ability | 2 | A ContinuousAbility whose modifiers/keywords/restrictions apply to EVERY card matching a CardSelector (recomputed live), not a single TargetRef. Per-target values may derive from the target ('lose life equal to printed life minus 2'). Needed for team buffs/debuffs that aren't one-shot tactics. |
| `cost-modifier` | implemented | ability | 3 | Continuous 'a given player (self/opponents/all) must pay +N / pays -N (min M) to deploy cards matching <selector or named subtype>'. Feeds getCardPlayability/playCard cost math. Vilghame, Ensmallment Ray, Port Manteau; very common. |
| `count-resource-icons` | implemented | expression | 3 | NumberExpression { type:'resourceIcons', player, icon } = how many of a given resource icon a player controls in play (face-up resource icons + Volition for face-down). Also serves 'while you control at least [X][X]' threshold-style gates via numberCompare. High-frequency across every Seed-era set. |
| `damage-modifier` | implemented | ability, battle | 1 | Static/continuous 'when battle (or any) damage is inflicted to <selector>, increase/decrease the amount by N', applied during damage assignment. Distinct from replacement-effect (adjusts an amount, doesn't cancel). Shieldmane Grandchest; common in Seed 2. |
| `damage-prevention-shield` | implemented | effect, state | 0 | Effect { type:'preventDamage', target, amount, mode:'reduce' | 'redirect', redirectTo? } + a serializable per-card runtime shield list consumed as damage is inflicted this turn, expiring end of turn. 'Reduce the next damage inflicted to the character this turn by 2.' (Tiny Shiny); 'The next X damage that would be inflicted to the first picked card this turn is inflicted to the second picked card instead.' (Delectable Boon). Distinct from ContinuousAbility.damageModifiers (needs a live in-play source) and the redirectDamage keyword (battle-only, all damage). |
| `damage-self-cost` | implemented | cost | 1 | Cost { type:'dealDamage', target, amount } — pay by inflicting damage on a card you control (typically 'source'), used by locations that spend their own structure. Intriguing Mezzanine ('Inflict 1 damage to this location. If you do, ...'). |
| `deck-position-ref` | implemented | expression, effect | 3 | Reference the top / bottom N cards of a deck: a TargetRef/selector form ({ type:'deckPosition', player, from:'top'|'bottom', count }) and a `position` option on moveCard's destination when to==='deck'. Axeclaw (cost of top card), Stone of Triumph (put on top), Geiseric / Cowslaw digging. |
| `deploy-from-zone` | implemented | effect | 0 | Generalise deployForFree to source zone 'play' (a face-down permanent/tactic) or 'discard': { type:'deployFromZone', chooser, declaration, free?, } — the chosen card is DEPLOYED (a tactic resolves; a permanent enters play) without paying its numeric cost; threshold and non-numeric extra costs still apply; resolves synchronously as a nested consequence. 'Reveal a face-down tactic you control. You may deploy the tactic.' (Manifest, Hidden Ruins, Accidental Invention, Burly Assailment); 'Pick a non-resource card in your discard pile. You may deploy the card.' (Dark Awakening). |
| `deploy-history` | implemented | state, condition | 1 | Per-turn record of what each player deployed (by name) so a condition can ask 'did an opponent deploy >=2 cards with the same name this turn'. Refrigerator Alarm. |
| `detach-effect` | implemented | effect | 0 | Effect { type:'detach', target } — clears CardInstance.attachedTo (a resource stops being attached to a faction; an Attach-to-X item is left unattached and cleaned up by the state-based check). 'You may pick a resource attached to your faction. If you do, detach it from your faction.' (Braggadocian Aide). |
| `duplicate-stack-card` | implemented | effect | 0 | Effect { type:'duplicate', target } — instantiate a transient copy of the targeted tactic/card on the response stack (same definitionId, owner = original owner, a fresh CardInstance in a 'deploying' zone), resolve its effects under the current controller, then the copy ceases to exist (like a token). 'Duplicate the tactic. Terminate the tactic.' (Muddle). |
| `facedown-selector` | implemented | expression | 0 | CardSelector.faceDown?: boolean. When true, match face-down in-play cards by their REAL definition.type (today face-down cards are excluded from any type-matched selector, SpoilsEngine ~L2476). Enables 'a face-down tactic/item/location/character/resource you control' targets (Foment, Manifest, Hidden Ruins, Accidental Invention, Burly Assailment, Implosive Explosion) and conditions on 'while this card is a face-down resource' (Fired Hand, Vorpal Sword). |
| `flip-face-down` | implemented | effect | 0 | Effect { type:'flipFaceDown', target } — flip an in-play card (character/item/location/resource) face-down under its OWNER's control. Per RULES.md §2 (CR §411.3/§411.4) the flip is 'leaves play' + 'a brand-new card enters play': damage/tokens/attachments/temp text all cleared; the result is a face-down resource providing Volition. Also the tactic self-disposition form 'Put this card into play under its owner's control as a face-down resource instead of into their discard pile' — authored as the tactic's own effect { type:'flipFaceDown', target:'source' }; finishStackItem/finishFlipUp bookkeeping must detect the source already re-entered play and skip the move-to-discard. Pervasive from the FLIP UP era on (~28 Seed 2 cards). |
| `flip-up` | implemented | cost, context | 5 | Alternate deploy path: a card may be played face-down as a resource now and later 'flipped up' by paying its FLIP UP cost (icons + sometimes an influence loss / bonus action). Needs (a) a play mode that pays an alternate Cost[] parsed from a 'FLIP UP: ...' clause, (b) a resolution-context flag deployedViaFlipUp readable by conditions/variables, (c) a face-down permanent that remembers its flip-up cost. Pervasive from Seed 2 on. |
| `for-each-player` | implemented | effect | 2 | Effect { type:'forEachPlayer', order, effects } running sub-effects once per player with `controller`/`owner` rebound to that player (turn order). Community Chest, Spatchcocking. |
| `grant-ability-text` | implemented | ability | 1 | A continuous effect that grants ability/keyword/Unique DATA (not printed English) to every card matching a selector, with values keyed off each card ('gains Unique X where X is its name'). God's Autograph. Rare, large; likely deferred past the pilot. |
| `has-unique-condition` | implemented | condition | 1 | Condition / CardSelector predicate 'card has a Unique designation' (unique != null). Trivial once `unique` metadata is populated. Prestige Inversion. |

Intriguing Mezzanine. |

(Conscientious Objector — onPlay.targets remembers it, a continuous self-restriction gates on it). |

[IMPLEMENTED: mandatory + optional forms, events moveToZone / destroy. replaces.controlledBy scopes on whose card is affected; replaces.by ('self'|'opponent'|'any') scopes on who initiated it ('by an opposing card or effect') incl. lethal battle damage.
